name: ProtagonistsRemorse
source:
What if you were the unwanted, unpicked "childhood friend" option in a dating sim? And what would it be like for the protagonist to realize he wanted to change his mind after?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241107162810/https://sauceco.itch.io/protagonistsremorse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你是约会模拟游戏中不受欢迎的、未被挑选的“儿时朋友”选项怎么办？当主角意识到自己想改变主意后会是什么样的感觉？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241107162810/https://sauceco.itch.io/protagonistsremorse]itch.io[/url]]
